name: Denmark
convention: Danmarks Nationalbank bank-closure days. KEY FINDINGS: (1) Store Bededag (Great Prayer Day) was abolished from 2024 and banks did NOT retain it — absent from the 2026/2027 Nationalbanken tables. (2) Danish banks close the Friday AFTER Ascension Day every year — a longstanding bridging closure distinct from Store Bededag. (3) May 1 is NOT a Danish bank closure day (it is not in the Nationalbanken tables), unlike every other Nordic. (4) Dec 24 and Dec 31 are closure days by collective agreement, and June 5 (Constitution Day) is treated as one. Weekend-falling named holidays included, flagged in notes.
sources: danlon.dk and bnpparibas.dk prior-year tables (2025 pattern cross-check)

confidence.2025: pattern-confirmed via secondary sources + the 2024 primary table; no direct 2025 Nationalbanken table (past year)
confidence.2027: confirmed against Danmarks Nationalbank directly (one weekday typo in the source table corrected: 2027-12-31 is a Friday, not a Thursday — anchored on 2026-01-01 = Thursday)

notes: Weekend-falling entries kept: 2026-12-26 (Sat), 2027-06-05 (Sat), 2027-12-25 (Sat), 2027-12-26 (Sun). Denmark has no substitute-day shifting.
The day-after-Ascension closure (2025-05-30, 2026-05-15, 2027-05-07) is expressible as offsetFrom(ascension, +1) — a second natural use of the offsetFrom primitive.
v1's DK table should be checked against this set before migration — the bridging Friday and the absence of May 1 are the two entries a generic Nordic template gets wrong.
